# Gunicorn CVE fixture

Purpose-built minimal-slice fixture using the unmodified Gunicorn 21.2.0 parser affected by
CVE-2024-1135. This is `kind: fixture`, not an independent repository cohort member. Exact
upstream, advisory, licensing, and ground-truth provenance are recorded in
`expected_findings.json`; the advisory and patch are reviewer evidence, not tool output.
